events.title: Quality of Life Update! Bigger Fonts, Better Readability & Menu Improvements

events.title: The Canon Keeper Is Getting Closer to Launch
events.summary: We’ve been hard at work on The Canon Keeper as we get closer to release.The game has now been localized into six different languages, making it accessible to even more players around the world.
